fields.label: Access
fields.description: Read only is the calendar, occupancy, bookings and the statement. Manage can also hold their own units out of sale. Neither creates a guest booking or edits a price. Guest name and phone stay off unless Show guest contact is ticked.

fields.label: Show guest contact
fields.description: Off by default. When on, this owner's logins see the guest's name and phone for their own units. Identity documents are never included.

fields.label: Commission %
fields.description: Taken off room revenue on the owner's monthly statement. The payout is room revenue minus this commission. Itemised costs are not on the statement yet.

fields.label: Logins
fields.description: Each address is a login for these units. A new address is created as a user with no welcome mail; set the password in Staff & Access.
